_note: The organisation's plan per period = the agent's mandate per line (base currency minor units). auto_share_bp: the part the agent may spend on its own; alert_share_bp: utilisation at which an alert is raised (require_approval_on_alert makes it a hard stop); bypass: unlimited line, honoured only when signed. Realized spend and granted extra come from the execution store at run time. period_start/period_end define the cut-off: obligations due after period_end carry forward to the next period; a closed period (POST /v1/budgets/{period}/close) issues its statement and no longer takes autonomous spend.
